author: ToolUp Analytics Ltd (UK)
name: ToolUp Platform SDK Module
description: Four-file analysis module (SharedTypes, Server, ClientModel, ClientView) plus .fsproj and .Client.props. Compiles cleanly against ToolUp.Platform.Core only — the dependency floor for minimum-viable modules.

app.description: Target application name (required when the solution has more than one application; the module is registered into <App>-Server's Server.fs and <App>-Client's Client.fs entry points). Leave empty for single-app solutions.

datatype.description: Optional DataTypeId for file processing (informational; surfaced as a comment in Server.fs).

manualInstructions.text: Add the new project to your .sln (dotnet sln add path/to/MyModule.fsproj).
Add <ProjectReference Include="..\Modules\MyModule\MyModule.fsproj" /> to the target server fsproj.
Add <Import Project="..\Modules\MyModule\MyModule.Client.props" /> to the target client fsproj.
Register the module in the target Server.fs and Client.fs entry points.
